posts.caption:
Blood cells from an 80 year old became neural stem cells with a molecular age under 20 🧬

Source: Berg, Franzen, Buness, Konang, Sheng, Peitz, Till, Wagner, Brüstle (University of Bonn, RWTH Aachen University), “Protracted Fate Acquisition and Epigenetic De-Aging During Induced Neural Stem Cell Conversion of Human Blood Cells”, Aging Cell, 2026.
